svg.desc: u32 · random · 1,000,000: Tessera −25.8% improvement; u32 · random · 65,536: Tessera −17.7% improvement; u64 · random · 1,000,000: Tessera −17.2% improvement; u32 · reverse · 1,000: Tessera −12.9% improvement; f64 · random · 65,536: Tessera −11.6% improvement; u64 · two clusters · 1,000,000: Tessera −11.5% improvement; u64 · reverse · 48: Tessera −10.5% improvement; {u64,u32} · all equal · 48: Tessera −10.4% improvement; u64 · reverse · 1,000: Tessera −7.9% improvement; f64 · finite floats · 65,536: Tessera −7.7% improvement; u64 · sorted · 48: Tessera −7.3% improvement; u64 · all equal · 48: Tessera −6.9% improvement; u64 · random · 65,536: Tessera −6.6% improvement; u64 · random · 1,000: Tessera −6.2% improvement; u64 · runs · 65,536: Tessera −6.0% improvement; f64 · finite floats · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −27.4% improvement; u32 · random · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −23.2% improvement; u32 · random · 65,536, 4 threads: Tessera −23.1% improvement; f64 · random · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −12.9% improvement; u64 · two clusters · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −9.5% improvement; u64 · random · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −9.3% improvement; u64 · runs · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −8.9% improvement; u64 · sparse digits · 1,000,000, 4 threads: Tessera −8.4% improvement
